text:
Rae: heads-up: EdgeScale asked for a marketplace structure that blends committed spend, a tiered hardware "staircase" credit, and multi-cloud listing rules. want to avoid extra billing touch. who can take the gating decisions? :wave:
Tom: happy to own tier math. idea: make the hw benefit a staircase that increases after usage milestones instead of a single upfront credit. reduces churn risk.
Selene: clarify operationally: staircase means partial credits unlocked at 3, 6, 9 months based on usage thresholds? that sounds doable but we need clawback rules.
Vik: from finance: staggered credits acceptable if we treat them as deferred credits and release to revenue as milestones hit. need clear SKU mapping for each tranche e.g., edge.hw.credit.tranche1.
Tom: draft proposal:
```
Base commit term: 12 months
Tiers:
- Peak: >= $600k/year -> 26% platform discount; hw staircase total $120k unlocked as: $30k at 3mo if >=25% usage, $40k at 6mo if >=60% usage, $50k at 9mo if >=95% usage
- Mid: $250k-$599k -> 16% discount; hw staircase total $45k unlocked as: $10k/3mo, $15k/6mo, $20k/9mo
- Entry: $90k-$249k -> 8% discount; hw staircase total $8k unlocked as: 40% at 3mo, 30% at 6mo, 30% at 9mo
Activation floor: $90k ARR
Clawback: prorated repayment for any unused/tranche credits if cancel <120 days; beyond that, only future tranche payments stop.
```
Rae: nice. two asks: (1) make tranche unlock conditions simple (pct of committed monthly run-rate) so SIs can validate, (2) publish both partner-visible SKU (for quoting) and an internal ledger SKU (for accounting).
Selene: ops note: marketplace catalog needs fields: partner_sku, internal_sku, commit_amount_usd, term_months, tier_label, base_discount_pct, staircase_definition (list as string), tranche_unlock_days, tranche_unlock_pct_of_commit, clawback_days, activation_floor_usd, restricted_listing_bool. i'll draft the API change request.
Vik: accounting specifics: each tranche must map to a deferred revenue liability line until condition met. prefer invoice line for unlocked tranche. Also want a 6mo holdback on marketing co-fund until first tranche unlocks.
Tom: marketing holdback OK. we can call it "co-fund holdback" and release on first tranche. how should we word that for partners?
Rae: simple: "Initial co-fund held until first usage milestone met; released automatically as invoice credit." legal to confirm.
Selene: legal/PR note: partners want joint announcement rights; require mutual sign-off and embargo window. add a metadata flag in the offer: pr_embargo_days and pr_contact.
Vik: finance also requests renewal staircase: if customer renews and hits >=90% of prior commit, apply a renewal uplift credit equal to 2% of prior year spend as a single invoice credit. must be a separate SKU: renewal.uplift.credit.v1.
Tom: ops: need marketplace UI changes to show staircase progress and next milestone. SIs asked for a printable one-pager. can we show tranche progress via billing portal?
Selene: yes, we'll add a tranche balance line and a milestone progress meter in the billing UI. eng-catalog will need partner_id and restricted_listing tag to control visibility.
accounting-bot: created task #ACCT-5182: "Define ledger SKUs for EdgeScale staircase tranches" and assigned to Vik; due in 3 business days.
comms-bot: draft calendar "EdgeScale co-sell kickoff" scheduled T-21; invites to partnerships, finance, legal, product, eng-catalog, SI leads.
Rae: next steps: Tom finalize tier numbers and tranche math; Vik to file ledger SKU plan and accounting treatment; Selene to write API change request + UI tickets; i'll assemble a partner-facing one-pager and PR blurb for legal review. will post ADO card when done. thanks all :rocket:
